author: TeIq
content: **Pre-flight (architect).** Inside AtprotoOauthAuthVerifier::complete_login_impl, after the moderators upsert, run inside the same tx: SELECT count(*) FROM moderator_roles. If 0 (first moderator system-wide), INSERT (moderator_id, 'admin', granted_at, NULL) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING. Audit-log entry via AuditLog::record with kind='first_user_admin_grant' payload={moderator_id, handle}. New /api/whoami endpoint (GET, authed) returns {moderator_id, roles, first_run, handle}. Frontend wire pending #84.
